## Outcome
Shorten required PR validation so agents spend substantially less time waiting for CI. Run complete platform-independent core coverage on Linux and focused native-platform coverage on Windows/macOS, while preserving meaningful assurance.

## Evidence
PR #572 Windows job110166769843 in run36798323562 spent1438.554seconds on its first243 workflow tests; runner setup took about7seconds. It failed before later validation suites. The current platform runner discovers all test_workflow_*.py on both Windows and macOS, while Linux discovers the full .agents suite. Static inspection found143 wrapper regression invocations covering106 distinct targets;25 targets recur, up to4times. These counts identify potential duplication, not measured attribution of the24minute runtime. The public repository uses standard runners, so this goal addresses feedback latency rather than a claimed minute-quota charge.

## Acceptance criteria
- Keep complete core behavioral, DAG, review, migration, policy and repository-contract coverage on Linux. Windows/macOS run explicitly selected installation/CLI smoke tests and relevant native filesystem, CRLF/Git checkout, path, process/liveness and package contracts, plus a small end-to-end journey.
- Produce a reviewable mapping of existing coverage to the new platform selections. Explain platform-sensitive obligations and preserve unique behavioral assurances; do not simply skip failing tests, reduce assertions, or infer portability from Linux success alone. Mocked OS branches do not replace required native observations.
- Measure per-test or per-group durations and publish concise CI timing summaries exposing the slowest work and selected test counts. Establish a baseline before editing and measure the final exact-head CI, separating setup, queue delay and test execution.
- Remove or avoid duplicate execution of expensive equivalent regressions where inspection proves the same assurance is retained. Do not restore long correction loops or repeated whole journeys merely to retain old test identifiers. Test fixtures remain isolated and fresh-process discovery works.
- Target under5minutes total execution for each Windows/macOS validation job on standard hosted runners, measured on representative successful exact-head runs without assuming a warm cache. Record full workflow wall time and Linux runtime too; splitting jobs must not merely hide duplicated work or increase aggregate execution without a documented benefit. If preserving necessary native coverage makes the target infeasible, present measured remaining cost and obtain a revised budget before claiming done.
- Required-check aggregation remains truthful: every configured required platform must actually pass; failures, cancellations and missing results cannot become successful by selection or reporting. Preserve current independent review and merge authority.

## Scope and relationships
Own this repository's CI selection, runtime diagnostics and removal of demonstrably redundant test execution. Coordinate with #557, which owns a broader durable test plan and reusable verification, and #570, which owns isolated dependency imports. Reuse those implementations where available without requiring their whole redesign to deliver this bounded improvement. #498 supplies the current DAG tests being measured; inspect the actual integrated implementation when execution begins. No parent or mandatory dependency is inferred solely from overlap. This capture does not reorder the main thread's previously approved queue.

## First falsifiable probe
Collect timings and selected test identities for the existing Windows/macOS workflow groups, identify duplicate journey targets, then propose the smallest coverage-preserving platform split. Demonstrate a measured reduction on native hosted runners and audit that all unique core/native obligations remain executed in the required workflow.

## Risks and authority
Main risks are losing native-only coverage, confusing mocked platform behavior with native behavior, order-dependent fixtures, misleading timing measurements and false-green required checks. The user approved recording this work as a high-priority goal after discussing the platform split and five-minute target. Capture only; no implementation, CI cancellation, policy change or merge is authorized by this request. All acceptance work above is required; unrelated enhancements belong to separate goals.
